title: Preparation of Plasma Samples from Rats
author: J Paul Robinson
materials: When stopped, remove the strip tube.

steps.title: Prepare Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Turn on the Hettich Mikro 22R refrigerated centrifuge (Cat # 1110) to allow it to cool down to 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Culex Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare 5 Culex tubes (Vial Clear 8mm Crimp Rnd Bottom 300 µl Lot:0000071223 MicroLiter Wheaton Company) with protease inhibitor and labels.

substeps.instruction: Add 15 µL of Protease Inhibitor Cocktail (Merck MilliporeSigma/Sigma-Aldrich Catalog #P2714-1BTL) to each of the 5 tubes.
Firmly place the cap (Snap Cap 8mm, Natural with Cut T/S Septa Lot 0000000308 MicroLiter Wheaton Company) ensuring it is level.
Place reusable plastic number labels 1-5 on each tube, positioned up from the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Set Up Collection Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare the Culex machine and PCR strip tubes for sample collection.

substeps.instruction: Place the prepared Culex tubes into slots 1-5 of the Culex Automated Blood Collection System (NxT).
Apply labels (Dymo, Cat# 1750283) to the strip tubes if not already labeled.
Place the strip tubes in an IsoFREEZE PCR Tube Chiller Rack (RPI, 248002) to maintain temperature throughout the process.

steps.title: Process Individual Samples
steps.instruction: Process each sample (S1 through S5) immediately as it is collected from the Culex machine.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample immediately using program #3 (4 °C, 10 minutes, 1000 x g / 3,000 rpm).
Using a P100 pipette (Pipettman, Cat#75874-574), set to 85 µL, carefully remove as much plasma as possible and transfer to the appropriate PCR strip tube.
If necessary, set the P100 pipette to 15 µL to remove remaining plasma without disturbing the red cell layer.
Mark the label on top of the original collection tube with an orange dot using an orange sharpie.

steps.title: Centrifuge Strip Tubes
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the collected plasma in the strip tubes using the Hettich Mikro 22R.

substeps.instruction: Change the centrifuge rotor to the one compatible with strip tubes.
Select program #2 (4 °C, 10 minutes, 6,000 rpm, RCR 4020).
Close the lid and press start; the machine will automatically stop once it recognizes the rotor change.
Open the lid, close it again, and press START to run the program.

steps.title: Aliquot Plasma Samples
steps.instruction: Create aliquots for each sample using P200 and P100 pipettes.

substeps.instruction: Using a P200 set to 25 µL (and P100 as needed), create two 25 µL aliquots for every sample.
Mark an "S" on the cap of any aliquot that is short of the required volume.

steps.title: Final Centrifugation and Storage
steps.instruction: Finalize sample preparation and store at low temperature.

substeps.instruction: Spin the aliquoted samples again on program #2 to collect all sample at the bottom of the tubes.
Ensure all lids are tight and place samples in a -20 °C freezer (stored in a labeled Ziploc bag).
Transport 25 µL samples using the ISO Freeze sample rack to maintain a temperature of 4 °C.

steps.title: Log Samples into Software
steps.instruction: Digitize the sample records using MPLEX software.

substeps.instruction: Log samples into the next plate map using the MPLEX software.
Print a copy of the plate map after each sample set is added for recording purposes.
